title: Study of a water jar
provenance: Acquired by the late Haji Abdul Kadir in 1920 from a family estate in Batu Gajah, Perak. Sold at Soh Yee's Antiques, Kuala Lumpur in 1975 to Dr. Ng Boon Yeong, who donated it to the MFA archives in 2019.
previous_owner: Collection of the late Dato' R. Sivanathan
